errors.what: The foot path is not the characteristic flat-bottomed Jansen walking curve. It is a lopsided, tilted teardrop with a pointed lowest tip (foot_y goes -96, -106, -111, -100, -84 over 90 to 210 deg, with no straight, level ground-contact phase). This suggests wrong link proportions or the wrong assembly branch.

Around crank 180 to 210 deg the lower links (the X-W link and the V-U and Z links) fold nearly collinear and overlap near the knee, which points to a near-singular or flipped assembly configuration. The drawn link topology around the knee also does not obviously match the spec: the link from V seems to end at the crank pin side, and the X link seems to reach the knee triangle's apex.
